keyFindings.description: GitHub reports #2472 as CONFLICTING with main, which has 39 commits past the fork point adee0aba. Files both sides change: biome.json, packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md, packages/dispatch/e2e/mermaid.e2e.ts, packages/dispatch/web/src/features/refs/MarkdownBody.test.tsx, packages/dispatch/web/src/features/refs/mermaid-diagrams.ts, packages/dispatch/web/vite.config.ts, packages/proof-editor/AGENTS.md. GitHub runs no checks on a conflicting head, and the merge cannot happen. Reintegrate main by a merge, then rerun the proof on the merged head.

No CI ran at the code head. The newest pull_request run is at f3f2427a (lint, typecheck, test and pr-title passed there). 496afccf and c7ed921a change packages/dispatch/e2e/mermaid.e2e.ts and were pushed under a head that carries skip-checks: true, so the compare from f3f2427a to 59c090e1 is not handoffs-only. The forward-merge push carries no trailer and starts the runs. The four required checks must be green at that code head before approval (the INFRA-138 architect, 23:10Z).

The remount fix (f3f2427a) is held only by browser rows that catch it some of the time: the round-2 VersionView failed only 5 of 40 runs. One CI pass would likely miss a revert of the memo, or a lint-driven re-add of `highlight` to the effect's dependencies. Add a unit case: rerender with an equal new highlight object and expect `editors` to stay at length 1; rerender with a different comment and expect a second editor.

roundTwoThreads: PRRT_kwDORFy7ds6xVEJw answered as accepted (fixed in f3f2427a); the implementer has already resolved it.
cleanupFastFollow: The VersionView.tsx:55-59 comment names ArtifactDocument as the parent, but the parent is ProofDocument; state the rule in the present tense. Move the no-diagram version row and recordScrollEachFrame to doc.e2e.ts. Make the scroll-each-frame row fail on a large drop, not only on a drop to 0. Round-2 items still stand: split mermaid.e2e.ts (now 1226 lines), remove focusInEditor's unused refocus parameter, merge the view's two clear-preview copies, use an Exclude type for the cache.

thermonuclear.deepReview: APPROVE. No Medium or High. Minor: no deterministic regression lock (raised above), and the scroll row only catches a drop to exactly 0. Checked: the effect re-runs on a change of comment, quote, markdown, blockSchema, user or createEditor, and on nothing else; blockSchema and userQuery.data stay stable through structural sharing.
thermonuclear.codeQuality: The memo is the simplest key that passes lint. Findings are a deterministic unit test, the row's placement and the comment wording.
